validation.gitUrlInvalid: Must be an http(s)/git URL without credentials

accessHint.noAddressTitle: This stack has no address yet
accessHint.noAddressBody: Stack containers only expose ports inside the Docker network. To open it from a browser, set it up in the SettingsAccess tab: use a domain through the proxy (e.g. wordpress.localhost for dev — *.localhost points to this computer automatically) or IP & port (a direct host port, e.g. 8080opens at http://{host}:8080), then Redeploy.
accessHint.proxyOff: The reverse proxy is not running — for domains, enable it first in Infrastructure<arrow></arrow>Reverse proxy.
accessHint.proxyDown: The proxy is not running — domains cannot be opened yet.

form.templateHint: Copied from the template when created; edit it freely. How services are reached (domain or IP & port) is set in the Access card.
form.composePathHint: Relative to the repo root; relative paths inside it (build, volumes) are resolved from this file's folder.
form.envHint: Written to .aoox.env and used as the source for {varExample} interpolation in the compose file (not passed into containers automatically — use environment: or env_file: .aoox.env). Supports {projectRef}.
form.envHintDb: Written to .aoox.env and used as the source for {varExample} interpolation in the compose file (not passed into containers automatically — use environment: or env_file: .aoox.env). Supports {projectRef} and {databases}.
form.saved: Saved — applies on the next deploy.

history.webhookTitle: Triggered by a push to the repository

statusStrip.deleteDescription: All stack containers are stopped and removed, along with their data volumes and the checkout copy. Data in the volumes is lost permanently and this cannot be undone.

webhook.templateNote: This stack was created from a template, so there is no repository to watch — pushes are ignored.

access.title: Access
access.description: How services are reached from outside — applies on the next deploy.
access.domainLine: Domain: through the proxy (Traefik), point DNS to this server.
access.proxyOff: The proxy is not running (Infrastructure<arrow></arrow>Reverse proxy).
access.ipPortLine: IP & port: the port is published directly on the host, opened via http://{host}:{port} without a domain/proxy.

mounts.addDescription: Volume: persistent data that survives deploys. Bind: a folder/file on the host (owner/admin only). File: a small config file stored here and mounted read-only. Applies on the next deploy.
mounts.detachDescriptionVolume: The mount is detached from the container. Choose what happens to its Docker volume: keep it (data stays) or delete it too (data is lost permanently and this cannot be undone).
mounts.detachDescriptionOther: The mount is detached from the container. This cannot be undone.

resources.title: Resource limits
resources.description: Per service in the stack — empty means no limit. Applies on the next deploy.

page.settingsDescription: Changes apply on the next deploy.

newPage.title: New compose stack
newPage.description: Deploy a docker-compose.yml from a git repo; the services in it are built and run as they are.
